correctness.rationale: For the specified alternating nearest-neighbor four-cycle Kuramoto vector field the locked edge-flow equations reduce exactly to b0=b2=s-2a/K and b1=b3=s, 2a/K−1≤s≤1. The interval proves none for K<a and a unique all-cosine-zero quotient point at K=a. For K>a, the inverse-sine/supplementary 16 branch census produces exactly the principal sink, the all-complementary source, and four mixed/mixed arcs glued alternately at s-interval endpoints into one smooth embedded S1 (not four components). The Jacobian is -K/2 times signed weighted cycle Laplacian; independently computed its exact characteristic polynomial z²(z²−4(x²+y²)) for mixed weights (x,y,−x,−y). Quotient circle eigenvalues 0,±K sqrt(2−(s−2a/K)²−s²), x²+y²>0 for K>a, proving Morse–Bott normal saddle type. The concave quadratic gives exact sharp min 2sqrt(a(K−a)) at endpoints and max sqrt(2(K²−a²)) at s=a/K. Sink/source eigenvalues ±Kc,±Kc,±2Kc. Symbolic identity and several representative K/a endpoint calculations independently passed; finite samples only corroborate complete analytic branch census.
